purpose: Teach: 目録/一挙/チェンジ/扶養/誘致/下部/所在地/本編

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、商品目録を手作りされた
lines.en: When you were founding the company, father made the product catalogue by hand.
lines.style: Gentle, measured recollection. Soft opening. Reverent tone — not mournful, but honoring. Steady pace, like laying down memory stones. Small pause before the final thought.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは販路を一挙に拡大する戦略をとられた
lines.en: Yes. Father pursued a strategy to expand our sales channels all at once.
lines.style: Measured acknowledgment. Slight weight on 'strategy' — intellectual respect. Warm but steady. Not defending, confirming. Quiet conviction in his voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、組織を大胆にチェンジする勇気をお持ちだった
lines.en: He had the courage to restructure the organization boldly.
lines.style: Soft wonder underneath. Not loudly admiring, but the admiration is there. Pause before 'boldly' — weight of that word. Slight trailing off, like he's still understanding what that took.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員の扶養手当を厚くされた
lines.en: Yes. Father was generous with the staff benefits and allowances.
lines.style: Quiet reflection. No flourish. The fact speaks for itself in his voice. Warm, not cold. He's not explaining — he's remembering what mattered.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、海外取引先の誘致に熱心だった
lines.en: He was very active in recruiting overseas business partners.
lines.style: Soft admiration. Slight lift on 'active' — a small recognition of his father's energy. Unhurried pace. Trailing thought, like he's seeing it again.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは組織下部の声を大切にされた
lines.en: Yes. Father truly valued the voices of people at every level of the organization.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Gentle weight on 'truly' — it mattered to him. Steady, thoughtful pace. Warm without being sentimental. He's not explaining this; he's stating what he knows.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本社の所在地を慎重に選ばれた
lines.en: He chose the headquarters location with great care.
lines.style: Tender observation. Slight pause before 'care' — it mattered. Unhurried, almost meditative. The reverence of seeing a small decision as important. Soft close.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは事業の本編を見極められた
lines.en: Yes. Father could see the heart of the business — what truly mattered.
lines.style: Final affirmation, quiet and sure. Slight emphasis on 'heart' — the core understanding he's honoring. Slow, measured pace. Wisdom earned through watching. Gentle close, like settling something to rest.
